## About me

I am a **Lecturer in Building Engineering at the University of Plymouth**, in the School of Art, Design and Architecture. My research focuses on the interactions between buildings, urban climate and energy systems.

Before joining Plymouth, I was a Research Associate at the Welsh School of Architecture, Cardiff University (2023–2024).

## Collaboration {#collaboration}

I welcome interdisciplinary work linking building engineering, urban climatology, energy systems and climate adaptation. Areas of interest include:

- SUEWS–EnergyPlus coupling and multi-scale urban–building modelling.
- Climate-resilient retrofit, natural ventilation and overheating.
- Low-carbon heating and cooling and their interaction with local climate.
- Environmental monitoring, urban thermal exposure and data-driven analysis.

[Explore the research questions and related publications](../research/index.qmd).

## Prospective PhD students

I welcome enquiries about research aligned with these interests. Please email a brief outline of your proposed topic, relevant background and the research questions you would like to explore. My [institutional profile](https://researchportal.plymouth.ac.uk/en/persons/xiaoxiong-xie/) lists my availability for PhD enquiries; this invitation does not imply a funded studentship.
